summary: All research questions are now explained, so this turn closes the one inferred link in the new StopSign-resync account with source evidence and no new execution. The executed trace showed node 3 synced to accepted 37 without a StopSign and then receiving sequence-expected Decides that clamped at 37, but it did not show how the leader could decide 38 while its own log stopped at 37. Source reading answers that: handle_accepted advances the leader's decided index to a follower-reported accepted index once is_chosen counts an accept quorum at or beyond it, and is_chosen counts the leader's own accepted index together with follower indices reported in Accepted messages without inspecting the log. A leader whose prepare quorum never merged a log_sync containing the StopSign can therefore decide 38 from later Accepted replies while its local log still ends at 37; create_log_sync attaches only the local StopSign, which explains why its earlier AcceptSync carried none, and resend_messages_leader's StopSign branch is guarded by get_stopsign(), so such a leader sends neither AcceptStopSign nor the StopSign's Decide for the missing position. The update registers three sources (handle_accepted, is_chosen, create_log_sync), adds the behavior record and links it to the question. No execution is requested.
